project: SISO - Pick OC: Separacao Direta de Pedidos Aguardando Compra
description: Adiciona botao 'Separar' na aba Aguardando OC da separacao. Operador faz pick fisico no checklist enquanto backend resolve burocracia (marca recebido, posta estoque, gera NF). Pedido cai em 'Separado' com tag PICK OC. PRD completo em tasks/prd-pick-oc-separacao.md

userStories.title: API: iniciar aceita aguardando_compra

acceptanceCriteria: In src/app/api/separacao/iniciar/route.ts, add 'aguardando_compra' to the list of allowed starting statuses (alongside 'aguardando_separacao' and 'em_separacao')
Pedidos in 'aguardando_compra' transition to 'em_separacao' just like pedidos in 'aguardando_separacao'
Pedidos already in 'em_separacao' are still allowed (resume flow unchanged)
No other logic changes — same operador_id assignment, same consolidation RPC call
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Simple change: find the status validation check (likely an array or condition checking 'aguardando_separacao') and add 'aguardando_compra' to it. Also update the UPDATE query filter to include 'aguardando_compra' alongside 'aguardando_separacao' for the transition.

userStories.title: API: novo endpoint POST /api/separacao/concluir-oc
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to create the concluir-oc endpoint that completes OC separation by auto-resolving the compras flow and transitioning directly to 'separado'.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/app/api/separacao/concluir-oc/route.ts with POST handler
Request body: { pedido_ids: string[], operador_id?: string }
Validate auth via getSessionUser()
For each pedido: fetch all items from siso_pedido_itens, check ALL have separacao_marcado=true. If not → add to pendentes[]
For fully-marked pedidos, update OC items (compra_status NOT IN ('recebido','cancelado',null)): SET compra_status='recebido', compra_quantidade_recebida=compra_quantidade_solicitada

Resolve decisao: fetch pedido.empresa_origem_id → get empresa.galpao_id. For OC items with ordem_compra_id: fetch siso_ordens_compra.galpao_id. If OC galpao == origin galpao → 'propria', else → 'transferencia'. If no OC linked, default to 'propria'
Set separacao_galpao_id: for 'propria' use origin galpao, for 'transferencia' use OC galpao. Resolve first active empresa in that galpao for execution
Update pedido: decisao_final, status='executando', status_separacao='separado', separacao_concluida_em=now(), separacao_galpao_id
Insert job in siso_fila_execucao: tipo='lancar_estoque', pedido_id, empresa_id (the separating empresa), decisao=decisao_final, tentativas=0, status='pendente'
Add tag 'pick oc' to separacao_tags (append, don't replace existing tags)
Fire-and-forget: import { preCriarAgrupamentosEmLote } from '@/lib/agrupamento-service' and call for separados[] IDs
Record history event via registrarEvento(pedidoId, 'separacao_oc_concluida', { operador, decisao })
Return { separados: string[], pendentes: string[] }
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Reference src/lib/compras-release.ts for decisao resolution logic (lines ~80-130). Reference src/app/api/separacao/concluir/route.ts for the concluir pattern (validation, response shape, fire-and-forget labels). Reference src/lib/historico-service.ts for registrarEvento. The execution worker (src/lib/execution-worker.ts) will pick up the job and handle Tiny API calls (marcadores, stock posting, NF) asynchronously.

userStories.title: Frontend: botao Separar na aba Aguardando OC
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to add a 'Separar' action button to the Aguardando OC tab so operators can start OC separation from the separation page.
acceptanceCriteria: In src/app/separacao/page.tsx, add an action button block for activeTab === 'aguardando_compra' (same pattern as the 'aguardando_separacao' block around line 1061)
Button text: 'Separar {N} pedido(s)' with Play icon, same styling as the existing Separar button
Shows count of selectedIds.size or pedidos.length if none selected
On click: calls handleSepararSelecionados but the redirect URL includes '&modo=pick-oc' query param
Include the MoveButton dropdown if isAdmin (same pattern as other tabs)
Disabled when actionLoading
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: The handleSepararSelecionados function already exists and calls POST /api/separacao/iniciar then redirects to /separacao/checklist?pedidos=ids. Modify the redirect in this function (or create a wrapper) to append '&modo=pick-oc' when activeTab === 'aguardando_compra'. Look at how the aguardando_separacao button block is structured around line 1061-1092 and replicate for aguardando_compra.

userStories.title: Frontend: indicador OC no checklist
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to show a visual OC status badge on items in the checklist when they have a compra_status, so operators know which items are OC vs stock.
acceptanceCriteria: In src/app/separacao/checklist/page.tsx, read compra_status from the checklist-items API response
Add compra_status to the ChecklistItem interface (string | null)
For consolidated products: derive compra_status from the first underlying item's compra_status (or null if mixed)
Render a small badge next to the SKU or description for OC items: 'OC' text with color by status — aguardando_compra: amber bg, comprado: blue bg, recebido: emerald bg
Items without compra_status (null) show no badge — normal stock items
Badge styling: rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: The checklist consolidates items by produto_id across multiple orders. Each ConsolidatedProduct has an 'items' array of ChecklistItem. Use the first item's compra_status for the badge. Colors: aguardando_compra → 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-900/30 dark:text-amber-400', comprado → 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-700 dark:bg-blue-900/30 dark:text-blue-400', recebido → 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-900/30 dark:text-emerald-400'.

userStories.title: Frontend: checklist modo pick-oc usa concluir-oc
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the checklist to detect pick-oc mode and call the concluir-oc endpoint instead of the normal concluir when completing separation.
acceptanceCriteria: In src/app/separacao/checklist/page.tsx, read 'modo' from URL searchParams
Store isPickOC = modo === 'pick-oc' as a boolean
When isPickOC is true, the Concluir button calls POST /api/separacao/concluir-oc instead of POST /api/separacao/concluir
On success toast: 'Separacao OC concluida — N pedido(s) liberado(s)' instead of the normal message
On success redirect: back to /separacao?tab=separado (same as normal flow)
The normal concluir flow remains unchanged when isPickOC is false
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Look for the existing handleConcluir or similar function that calls /api/separacao/concluir. Add a conditional: if (isPickOC) use '/api/separacao/concluir-oc' else use '/api/separacao/concluir'. The request body shape is the same: { pedido_ids }. The response shape is the same: { separados, pendentes }.
